primitives.name: Teamwork Communication Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: --name: teammate whenToUse: "In-process teammate: ${agentName}" tools: '["*"], or the custom agent''s tools plus [SendMessage, TaskCreate, TaskGet, TaskList, TaskUpdate]' source: projectSettings permissionMode: default --<!-- Extracted verbatim from the Claude Code v2.1.211 binary.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a multi-agent system where each entity operates within defined permission boundaries and tool sets.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails when SendMessage is omitted, leading to information silos and coordination collapse.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's multi-model ensemble fusion via Bayesian model averaging, where agents represent independent samplers.

primitives.name: Message Send Tool Requirement
primitives.verbatim_quote: To communicate with anyone on your team, use the SendMessage tool with `to: "<name>"` to send messages to specific teammates.
primitives.assumptions: Operates under the assumption that direct text output is invisible to other team members.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down into miscommunication when tool usage is inconsistent across agents.

layer2.mapping: Analogous to conformal prediction intervals in GSE, ensuring all predictions are communicated within probabilistically valid bounds.
layer2.telemetry: Tool invocation frequency and success rate

primitives.name: Text Visibility Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: Just writing a response in text is not visible to others on your team - you MUST use the SendMessage tool.
primitives.assumptions: Relies on a clear separation between local processing and shared communication channels.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Degenerates into redundant computation when constraints are violated.

layer2.mapping: Mirrors the data filtering step in GSI's feature selection pipeline, where only processed signals are passed forward.

primitives.name: Task System Coordination
primitives.verbatim_quote: Your work is coordinated through the task system and teammate messaging.
primitives.assumptions: Presumes a centralized task queue that distributes work units to individual agents.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Collapses when the task queue becomes a bottleneck or fails to distribute tasks evenly.

layer2.mapping: Similar to load balancing algorithms in GSE's distributed computing framework, ensuring optimal resource allocation.
